package.name: easyfleet_easynav_navigation
package.description: The resources EasyFleet provides for building a navigation capability backed by EasyNav (easynav_system::GoalManagerClient). For now, just the Navigate BT.CPP node: drives EasyNav to the waypoint named by its "goal_id" input port, resolved against a fixed id->pose registry read from the blackboard (EasyNav itself has no named-waypoint concept). Built as a BT.CPP plugin (BT_REGISTER_NODES), loaded by path -- not a library a capability links against at compile time -- so any manufacturer/integrator can build their own EasyNav-backed capability (their own tree, their own bookend nodes, their own action-server class) around it without a compile-time dependency on this package beyond this one node. See easyfleet_easynav_deployment for a full reference capability implementation built this way.
